html.content:
Recommended

Densityscore: 1.0

Smooth kernel density estimate — overlay multiple groups.

Clinical use: Overlaid PK distributions across arms

  • 1+ numeric → density estimate
  • enough n for smooth density

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='density plot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

Alternatives

Scatter2Dscore: 1.0

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • sufficient points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

Histogramscore: 0.9

Binned frequency distribution of a single continuous variable.

Clinical use: Baseline characteristic distribution

  • 1+ numeric → frequency distribution
  • no category → single variable focus
  • enough data for bins

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='histogram of <numeric>'

Hexplotscore: 0.8

Hexagonal binning for large scatter datasets to avoid overplotting.

Clinical use: Large-scale biomarker vs response, high-n scatter

  • 2 numeric → hex binning
  • large n — hexplot prevents overplotting

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='hexplot of <num1> vs <num2>'

Contourscore: 0.8

2D density contour lines over a scatter.

Clinical use: Population density of two continuous biomarkers

  • 2 numeric → 2D density contour
  • large n — contour informative
  • pure bivariate — contour preferred over violin

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='contour plot of <num1> vs <num2>'
